headline: Preferred combining commissions into two groups of three; approved August meeting minutes.
summary: Members discussed possible changes to how city commissions are structured and stated a preference for two groups of three. Members unanimously approved the August meeting minutes. Staff and council updates covered the Main Street project, the Burlington-Winooski Bridge, and the capital plans.
decisions: Approved the August meeting minutes unanimously.
Recorded the commission's preference for two groups of three: Finance, MIC, & SHCP, and Housing, Planning, & I&B.

Commission preference: 1) Two groups of three listed above.

decision_titles: Commission structure: two groups of three
plain_text:
10/29/2026 - Minutes
Call to Order
MIC Members Present: Michelle Metzler, Chair; Micayla Schambura, Secretary; Gretchen 
Calcagni; Anna Vold
City Staff Present: Jon Rauscher, Public Works Director; Eli Ogilvie, City Councilor
Guests Present: N/A
Call to Order by: Michelle
Meeting Start Time: 6:34 pm
Minutes Recorded by: Micayla
Public Comment
N/A
Approve Previous Meeting Minutes
Motion by: Anna
Second: Gretchen
Decision: Approve
The minutes from the August meeting were unanimously passed.
Discussion: Commission Structure
Alternative A – Single Commission Model – No strong comments but doesn’t seem like the best 
permanent solution. Could be beneficial if there was a full time staff in charge of this.
Alternative C Ad Hoc Commission – We see some benefit to having a pre-selected group of 
people ready to go, but it may be an administrative burden to be coordinating. It might be 
beneficial for things that need closer attention that can’t wait until the monthly meeting, or one-off 
things but doesn’t seem like a great replacement for overall. 
Alternative B Combined – combining groups is the most favorable option. It puts people together 
bringing more community and keeps groups with momentum. Generally, the proposed groups 
make sense but there are concerns that I&B & SHB may be too similar and lack tasks. We 
suggest potentially pairing I&B with Finance and Safety with MIC instead. Finance and MIC pair 
well together operationally but both have concrete tasks. MIC also works with safety for parks, 
police department, etc. A lot of public comment is related to contacting the police for 
enforcement, and it might be good to have that sort of discussion with safety present instead of 
pushing the concern to the PD after the meeting.
Suggestion of two groups instead of 3:
1. Finance, MIC, & SHCP 
2. Housing, Planning, & I&B
Strong support of Finance, MIC, & SHCP – they are very intertwined in real world applications.
Commission preference: 1) Two groups of three listed above. 
 2) Three groups of two -- MIC & Safety, Finance & I&B, & Housing & Planning
We also support the idea of an ad-hoc committee for occasional things that pop up but it doesn’t 
seem like the best permanent stand-alone option.
Regardless of combinations, to integrate groups, we suggest combining groups initially and then 
organically figure out how many members should join/be capped at.
City Council Liaison Updates
Eli presented the following updates:
1. Vote on Tuesday, November 3rd! 
2. Budget process has begun – he would love to hear folks input throughout budget 
season.
This Monday there will be an electric vehicle meeting at City Hall discussing NEVI (National 
Electrical Vehicle Infrastructure).
Inclusion & Belonging Commission Update
N/A
City Staff Liaison Updates
Jon presented the following updates: 
1. DPW is wrapping up projects for the season. 
2. Main Street project is coming to a close. Some punch list items are left (e.g. signal 
work, few minor clean up things, nothing major). 
3. Hotel/housing on Abenaki Way is wrapping up. A walkthrough of the parking garage, 
discussion on winter operations, and punch list closeout are needed.  
4. Design build RFP went out last month for the Burlington-Winooski Bridge to the two 
pre-selected contractors. Now it will be a 6-month procurement process including 
meetings with those contractors until the contractor is selected. Targeting Summer 2027 
for contractor selection. Major construction of the bridge set for Summer 2028. For all 
Burlington-Winooski Bridge updates, see the following website. 
5. Hood’s Crossing is a little behind but targeting next year to get in place. 
Meeting with Finance Commission next month to review a draft of the Capital Plans. Jon will 
include the Water and Sewer capital plans as well.
Other Business
N/A
Adjourn
Motion by: Anna
Second: Gretchen
Meeting End Time: 7:18 pm
I.
II.

VIII.
